description: This line plot illustrates how initial and final model accuracy vary with population frequency, measured in units of 10^4. The x-axis, labeled “pop frequency (x10^4)”, spans from 1 to 19, with tick marks at regular intervals of 1. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy”, ranges from 0.0 to 1.0. The plot displays two lines: the “Initial Accuracy” is represented by a green line with square markers and error bars, while the “Final Accuracy” is shown as a blue line with triangle markers and error bars. The green line starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.35 at a population frequency of 1, rises to about 0.65 at frequency 3, dips to around 0.5 at frequency 5, and then gradually increases to approximately 0.85 at frequency 19. The blue line begins at about 0.7 at frequency 1, rises to a peak of roughly 1.0 at frequency 7, then fluctuates slightly before stabilizing near 0.95 at frequency 19.
